verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair axis for an agent platform with a hub, scheduling and Kanban, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events. The Slack, Discord, Telegram and Linear chat integrations are chat-app integrations, not webhooks. Cron scheduling and headless CI runs are different capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
